name: extract_phenotypes_and_covariates
title: Extractor Phenotypes and Covariates
summary: Extracts phenotypes and covariates directly from the Apollo dataset. Can subset to EUR ancestry, unrelated individuals, and correct lipids for statin usage.

inputSpec.name: dataset_id
inputSpec.help: The UKB Dataset Record ID (e.g., record-XXXXX)

inputSpec.name: pheno_list_file
inputSpec.help: Text file containing list of phenotype columns

inputSpec.name: additional_covars_file
inputSpec.help: Text file containing list of covariate columns

inputSpec.name: bim_file
inputSpec.help: The PLINK .bim file to extract the snplist. Will not return a snplist if left blank.

inputSpec.name: subset_unrelated
inputSpec.help: Calculate and filter out related samples via kinship matrix

inputSpec.name: statin_correction
inputSpec.help: Apply statin correction logic to cholesterol/LDL
